scenarios.title: Missing item shows a fallback
scenarios.requirement: Clicking View item with missing item data shows Item unavailable.
scenarios.expectedSource: Local demo contract: missing item fallback
preconditions: Use the local demo; item data is intentionally missing on a fresh page.

scenarios.title: Failed request explains the error and supports retry
scenarios.requirement: A 503 response shows Service unavailable. Retrying successfully displays Demo item.
scenarios.expectedSource: Local demo contract: deterministic first-request failure and retry
preconditions: Use the local demo; Load items returns 503 and Retry returns 200.
